exposure: Intrathecal Dexmedetomidine (0 µg, 2.5 µg, 5 µg, 10 µg) combined with 12.5 mg 0.75 % hyperbaric ropivacaine
cohort: 120 ASA II parturients scheduled for elective cesarean section.
finding: Adding 5-10 µg of intrathecal Dexmedetomidine to ropivacaine significantly improves hemodynamic stability and markedly prolongs spinal block and analgesia duration for cesarean section without clinically relevant side-effects.
